Card sections that often contain it: Hardware, Requirements, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Models with up to 30B parameters can be deployed on a single A100 GPU; the 38B model requires two A100 GPUs and the 235B model requires eight A100 GPUs.
